DMD 100.name: Digital Multimedia Design Foundations
DMD 100.description: Foundational concepts and tools of digital multimedia design.

DMD 300.name: Digital Multimedia Design Studio
DMD 300.description: Studio course applying digital multimedia design skills. Bulletin also requires '9 credits from ART 211Y, COMM 215, COMM 230W, DART 202, IST 140, IST 250' -- not modeled as a literal credit-count sub-prereq (the schema doesn't support 'any N of M'), but the Digital Multimedia Design B.Des. plan itself schedules five of those six courses (well over 9cr) in Semesters 1-3, long before this course's own Semester 7 placement, so the real requirement is always already satisfied in practice.

DMD 400.name: Digital Multimedia Design Capstone
DMD 400.description: Capstone course synthesizing the digital multimedia design curriculum. Bulletin credit max is 6 across repeated enrollments; modeled at 6cr for a single enrollment, matching the plan's own Semester 8 placement.
